message.reasoning:
**Evaluating trade strategies**

I need to decide on a post-turn action. I've got $327 cash but nothing to build. I could try trading for Ventnor with Grok, who has a yellow monopoly. My earlier offer of $371 was rejected, so I might need to increase it. Offering property could be risky, as I don’t have anything useful to spare. Grok only has Ventnor and Oriental, so they only need one more yellow property, which adds pressure. I wonder if my offer might persuade them before they can grab Atlantic from the bank.**Analyzing trading options**

Grok likely rejected my $371 offer because they want to build up their yellow properties. They have a lot of cash, so I might need to make a bigger offer or find more valuable trades. Offering St. James plus cash for Ventnor comes to mind, but that could strengthen them since I don’t have an orange monopoly. Maybe Illinois could work, but I worry it’s too much of a risk. I could mortgage one of my properties to raise cash, but that feels unnecessary right now. I think it’s probably best to end my turn instead.

function.name: end_turn
function.arguments: {"public_message":"Ending turn. Keeping cash flexible and not forcing a weak trade.","private_thought":"No strong post-turn action beats liquidity right now. Grok already rejected a big Ventnor bid, and any stronger offer would overpay into a weak position. Preserve cash for trades or defense."}
